current_article.title: Save the dates: Next Season’s Community Day events! — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
Save the dates: Next Season’s Community Day events!
Trainers,
Now that we’ve wrapped the final Community Day in the Season of Heritage, we’d like to share the Community Day dates for the next Season!
Sunday, March 13, 2022
Saturday, April 23, 2022
Saturday, May 21, 2022
Stay tuned for the upcoming Season’s announcement blog for more details on March’s Community Day and more!
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated. For the latest on in-game events and feature updates, be sure to check this help center article .
—The Pokémon GO team
